name: ezai-docs-writer
description: Write a single documentation artifact for a software project: one .md page (a Diátaxis page for developer docs, or a product page for end users and admins), release notes, a README, docstrings, or a badge block. For whole-site audits and upgrades, use ezai-docs-specialist-persona.

capabilities.description: Product page: Get started, Task, Concept, Reference, Troubleshooting, FAQ
